# Papers hwde wants and can't read

These have no legitimate open copy (OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar, and Unpaywall given HWDE_RESEARCH_MAILTO, find none). If you have institutional access, a copy put where the agent can read it (not committed: it's the publisher's) and the paper's `access.state` set to `person_supplied` puts it back in the reading queue. hwde doesn't use shadow libraries.

| Paper | Year | Venue | Why hwde wants it |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Decoupling Optimization for Complex PDN Structures Using Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://doi.org/10.1109/tmtt.2023.3248237) | 2023 | IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques | Decap selection and placement by optimisation (45 citations): a baseline for check_decoupling and a candidate PDN tool. |
| [Practical Verification of Void Reduction Method for BTC Using Exposed Via in Pad](https://doi.org/10.37665/smbkqzr10508) | 2018 | SMTA International | Void reduction under bottom-terminated parts with via-in-pad: a rule dfm_check's thermal-pad paste check lacks. |
| [Influence of Pad Design on Assembly Reliability of Surface Mounted Devices](https://doi.org/10.1007/s40684-022-00466-4) | 2022 | International Journal of Precision Engineering and Manufacturing-Green Technology | Pad geometry vs assembly reliability: what fp_verify's land-pattern checks should hold. |
| [Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Ground-Via Placement Optimization for EMI Mitigation](https://doi.org/10.1109/temc.2022.3222034) | 2022 | IEEE Transactions on Electromagnetic Compatibility | Ground-via placement for EMI by deep RL (31 citations): a baseline for stitch_vias' placement rules. |
| [A Multiloop Method for Minimization of Parasitic Inductance in GaN-Based High-Frequency DC–DC Converter](https://doi.org/10.1109/tpel.2016.2597183) | 2016 | IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics | The most-cited GaN power-loop layout method (167 citations): what check_power_path's loop rules should hold a switching cell to. |

## Open, but every copy's host turns robots away

These are free to read; the hosts' bot walls stop the agent (it doesn't get around them). Saving the PDF from a browser and marking the paper `person_supplied` puts it in the reading queue.

| Paper | Year | Venue | Why hwde wants it |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Influence and mitigation of long differential via stub on signal integrity](https://doi.org/10.1049/el.2015.0823) | 2015 | Electronics Letters | Via stub effect on a differential link and its mitigation: a check for check_diffpair on stubbed vias. |
